mapper.select: SELECT username AS "username", display_name AS "displayName", email AS "email", department AS "department", auth_source AS "authSource", remark AS "remark", mfa_enabled AS "mfaEnabled", password_hash AS "passwordHash" FROM edudoc_user WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex})
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_user SET display_name = #{displayName}, department = #{department, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, email = #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, remark = #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex})
UPDATE edudoc_user SET mfa_enabled = #{mfaEnabled}, remark = #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex})
UPDATE edudoc_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash} WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex})
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(MAX(occurred_at)), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || 'Z' AS "passwordUpdatedAt" FROM edudoc_audit_log WHERE actor_id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}) AND action_type = 'PASSWORD_CHANGE' AND result_code = 'SUCCESS'

SELECT RAWTOHEX(id) AS "id", TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(occurred_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || 'Z' AS "time", result_code AS "resultCode", source_ip AS "sourceIp", user_agent AS "userAgent" FROM edudoc_audit_log WHERE actor_id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}) AND action_type = 'AUTH' AND occurred_at >= #{since} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, RAWTOHEX(id) DESC FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT RAWTOHEX(id) AS "id", TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(occurred_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || 'Z' AS "time", result_code AS "resultCode" FROM edudoc_audit_log WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{sessionId}) AND actor_id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}) AND action_type = 'AUTH'
